proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s₁ s₂ T X hr _ hT hT2 ht
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hT
  have hT1 : dist T s₁.center = s₁.radius := ht.mem_sphere
  have h1 : T -ᵥ s₁.center = k • (s₂.center -ᵥ s₁.center) := by
    rw [← hk, AffineMap.lineMap_vsub_left]
  have h2 : T -ᵥ s₂.center = (k - 1) • (s₂.center -ᵥ s₁.center) := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right T s₂.center s₁.center, h1]
    module
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_smul] at h1
    rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V, h1, norm_zero] at hT1
    linarith
  refine ⟨hT2, ht.mem_space, ?_⟩
  intro Q hQ
  have h3 := ht.inner_left_eq_zero_of_mem hQ
  rw [h1, inner_smul_right] at h3
  have h4 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_left hk0
  refine EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.mem_orthRadius_iff_inner_left.mpr ?_
  rw [h2, inner_smul_right, h4, mul_zero]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s₁ s₂ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (T X : P), 0 < s₁.radius → X ≠ T → T ∈ line[ℝ, s₁.center, s₂.center] → T ∈ s₂ → s₁.IsTangentAt T line[ℝ, T, X] → s₂.IsTangentAt T line[ℝ, T, X]
